authoritative_support_available: Stata 19 [R] regress, p. 26 for N-k t reference degrees of freedom
evidence: OLSResult.summary() publicly labels and reports [95% Conf. Interval].
The implementation uses stats.t.ppf(0.975, df_resid) and coefficient plus or minus t critical times standard error.
No frozen formula_map.csv row defines or maps this quantity.
No independent numerical confidence-interval test was found.
findings.consequence: A publicly reported release-critical statistical formula lacks the required primary-source, assumption, parameterization, code, and test mapping; theory audit cannot pass.
findings.required_action: Add a frozen confidence-interval formula row with exact source location, N-k and two-sided 95% parameterization, normal-error limitation, OLSResult code location, and an independent numerical test for both supported constant conventions.

findings.authoritative_rule: For c=0, total df=N and total MS=TSS/N; Stata 19 [R] regress pp. 9-10 and 22-23.
findings.evidence: REG-NOCONSTANT-001 maps OLSResult._summary_style_stata but omits the existing test that directly verifies the public Total row; its listed oracle and tests cover normalized fit statistics instead.
findings.consequence: The frozen formula row does not provide the complete recorded implementation-to-independent-test trace required by the audit skill.
findings.required_action: Add the exact public-summary test ID to REG-NOCONSTANT-001 or a dedicated formula row in a newly frozen formula map.

decision_reasons: The publicly reported coefficient confidence interval has no frozen formula-map row and no independent numerical test.
REG-NOCONSTANT-001 omits the exact test ID for the public summary code it claims to map.
Primary papers, official documentation, source files, and tests were accessible, so BLOCKED_ENV does not apply.
Passing oracle and targeted tests do not override unmapped release-critical formulas.
